authorization_basis: User standing instruction to diagnose, fix or reject, freeze, test and continue without repeated routine approval; this is a newly bounded development substage, not reuse of another batch's call allowance.
scope: All original-arm compile-repair checkpoints in the fixed completed 312-row archive; not a complete batch or independent validation
selection_rule: Every A-arm failed lint with a captured following model request, excluding successful original deterministic declaration repair and exhausted repair budget; never select by grade
order: Sorted task IDs, AB for even index and BA for odd index; same compilation path reused only after owned child termination and evidence move
worker_inputs: Frozen generation and repair skills, identical first request and captured first response, prompt only; no reference, TB or grading input
grading: Pinned official evaluator and original archive task assets, loaded only after all 14 workers end; do not alter known dataset interfaces
measures: reconstructed time including shared archived initial inference
whole stage and grading wall time
research_signal_gate: All seven valid pairs complete, at least one L3 repair, zero L3 regressions, reconstructed C/A worker cost <= 1.10; passing only retains a research candidate
stop_rules: Stop on unconfirmed request, environment/identity/evidence/cleanup failure or frozen time/call budget; no quality-based early stopping, no redraw, no candidate adjustment after results
limits: All seven are seen development tasks; new independent natural tasks=0, effective independent design families unknown. No overall 156 score, fresh-generation latency, universal safety or official 32GB acceptance claim. Complete-batch data and budget admission remain separate.
